description: The rules house with the escape rule written for two editions of TEST-CODE, and a profile adopting 2021: only the 2021 rule, whose synthetic threshold is 7 sq ft, is in force, and the bedroom's 12 sq ft window passes it; the 2024 rule is listed with the reason "edition".
